rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the general act or state of relaxing, especially relief from stress or tension.

example.english: Listening to music after work gives me real relaxation.
example.traditional: 放工之後聽吓歌，真係好放鬆。
example.jyutping: fong3 gung1 zi1 hau6 teng1 haa5 go1 zan1 hai6 hou2 fong3 sung1

rows.note: Use this when relaxation specifically means resting or taking a break after effort, rather than recreational leisure.

example.english: After all that work, have some relaxation before doing anything else.
example.traditional: 做完咁多嘢，坐低休息一陣先啦。
example.jyutping: zou6 jyun4 gam3 do1 je5 co5 dai1 jau1 sik1 jat1 zan6 sin1 laa1

rows.note: Use this when relaxation means leisure or recreation undertaken for enjoyment and mental relief.

example.english: I most enjoy gaming for relaxation in my spare time.
example.traditional: 我平日最鍾意打機消閒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 jat6 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 daa2 gei1 siu1 haan4
